rule: FactGate counts an ERC-8004 validation score only when its validator is listed here for that chain. A score from any other validator is shown, never counted. Self-scores (validator = the agent's owner or agentWallet) never count. This default lists only validators whose every score anyone can re-compute from public records. Visitors can change the list on the page.

validators.name: Delivery Court judge
validators.operator: the FactGate author (this is the author's own validator)
validators.reproduce: Every score names its record (responseURI) and the exact body it judged (sha256 = responseHash). offchain/src/rejudge.mjs in the public Delivery Court repository (github.com/kzmttkc/reactive-delivery-court) re-reads the validationResponse call, checks the body hash and re-runs the model files to recompute the score.
